# FlightDelayCheck

> Free UK261 / EU261 flight compensation check built from three public records (the flight's actual arrival time, Eurocontrol's daily airport delay-by-cause data, and airport METAR weather), followed by an optional ready-to-send claim letter for £4.99 or a claim pack for £9.99. UK-based document service. Not a law firm, not a claims management company, no percentage fees; passengers can claim directly from the airline for free and the site says so on every page.

## What it answers

- Is my delayed or cancelled flight owed compensation under UK261 or EU261, and how much (£220 / £350 / £520 or €250 / €400 / €600 by great-circle distance, per passenger)?
- Did the flight actually arrive 3 hours or more late? (Verified from the flight record, gate or touchdown time.)
- Does the airline have a plausible "extraordinary circumstances" defence for that day? (Eurocontrol air-traffic delay causes at both airports and the airport weather observations.)
- Which regulation covers a route and carrier after Brexit, which ADR scheme (CEDR or AviationADR) hears disputes, and the limitation date.

## Key facts

- Threshold: 3 hours or more at arrival (doors open), Sturgeon C-402/07, Nelson C-581/10.
- Amounts UK261: £220 up to 1,500 km; £350 for 1,500 to 3,500 km; £520 over 3,500 km (£260 if 3 to 4 hours late). EU261: €250 / €400 / €600 (€300), intra-EU over 1,500 km = €400.
- Coverage: departing the UK (any airline) = UK261; arriving in the UK on a UK or EU airline = UK261; departing the EU/EEA/Switzerland (any airline) = EU261; arriving in the EU on an EU airline = EU261.
- Not extraordinary: technical faults (Wallentin-Hermann C-549/07, Huzar v Jet2 [2014] EWCA Civ 791), the airline's own staff strikes (Airhelp v SAS C-28/20), crew shortages, knock-on delays without reserve time (Eglitis C-294/10).
- Limitation: 6 years England and Wales, 5 Scotland; EU states 1 to 10 years.
- Free escalation: CEDR (British Airways) or AviationADR (most other airlines) after a final response or 8 weeks of silence.

## Data sources

- Flight records: AeroDataBox (flights within the last 12 months).
- Airport delay causes: Eurocontrol Performance Review Unit, airport arrival ATFM delay by cause, daily since 2019.
- Weather: METAR observations via the Iowa Environmental Mesonet archive.
- Airports: OurAirports.
